faq.title: Help & FAQ
faq.report: Report a bug or suggest an idea
faq.which_apk.a: "arm" fits any phone and TV box — take that one. "arm64-v8a" and "armeabi-v7a" are smaller but fit only one architecture: arm64 for modern phones, armeabi-v7a for older 32-bit TVs. "universal" fits everything, including x86.
faq.update.q: How do I update the app?
faq.update.a: Automatically: on start (at most twice a day) the player checks GitHub and offers an update. Manually: Settings → Updates → Check for updates. On the first update Android asks to allow installing from this app.
faq.update_failed.q: The update fails: "App not installed" or INSTALL_FAILED
faq.update_failed.a: Most often this is the "2160 Тест" debug build — it's a separate app and a release can't be installed over it (there "Update" opens the release page). Other causes: no free space, or an APK for a different architecture — download the "arm" build.
faq.tv_install.q: How do I install it on Android TV?
faq.tv_install.a: Easiest from a phone that already has the player: Settings → About → Share the app → "Share over Wi-Fi", then open the shown address on the TV in Downloader or a browser. A USB stick works too: copy the APK and open it in the TV's file manager.
faq.share.q: How do I share the player without internet?
faq.share.a: Settings → About → Share the app: "Send the file" (Quick Share, Bluetooth, Telegram) or "Share over Wi-Fi" — another device on the same network downloads the player straight from this one via a QR code. No router? Turn on the phone's hotspot. If you have a single-architecture build (arm64-v8a), the player downloads over Wi-Fi and keeps a package for all devices — a single copy, updated together with the player.
faq.scale.q: Black bars / the picture doesn't fill the screen
faq.scale.a: The "Video" button (frame icon, top right) → Scale: Whole picture, Fit width, Fit height, Fill screen (crop), Stretch. On a phone just pinch: spread two fingers to fill, pinch in to fit. The choice is remembered.
faq.dv.q: It says "Dolby Vision is not supported here — the HDR10 base layer is shown"
faq.dv.a: The device can't decode this Dolby Vision profile (usually profile 7 from UHD Blu-ray remuxes). Instead of playing sound only, the player shows the compatible HDR10 layer — the picture is correct, just without DV dynamic metadata.
faq.hdr_dark.q: An HDR movie looks dim or washed out
faq.hdr_dark.a: The screen doesn't support HDR — the player warns about it in File info (ⓘ button). Brightness depends on the screen; on a phone use maximum brightness and turn off power saving.
faq.no_video.q: Sound but no picture (or stuttering video)
faq.no_video.a: Open File info (ⓘ): it shows which decoder is used and whether it copes. Try Settings → Decoder: "Hardware" or "FFmpeg". High-bitrate 4K over Wi-Fi may not keep up — use a cable or a local drive.
faq.no_sound.q: No sound on the TV or receiver (AC3, DTS, TrueHD)
faq.no_sound.a: The player passes surround sound to the receiver undecoded when the output claims to support it. If the TV can't actually take the stream, the player retries after a second and then switches to decoding by itself. Still silent? Pick another track in the Audio panel or turn on Night sound (it always decodes).
faq.night.a: Dynamic range compression: quiet dialogue louder, explosions softer — watch at night without waking anyone. Turn it on in the Audio panel or by schedule (23:00–10:00 by default, changeable in Settings). While on, sound is decoded and downmixed to stereo; turning it off restores multichannel.
faq.audio_delay.q: Sound lags behind the picture (Bluetooth, soundbar)
faq.audio_delay.a: Audio panel → Audio delay: minus plays sound earlier than the picture. 50 ms steps; the value is remembered for all files (it depends on the headphones/soundbar, not on the movie).
faq.background.q: How do I listen in the background, or pause when minimized?
faq.background.a: Settings → "When the player is minimized": Picture-in-picture, Video in background (sound without picture) and Music and audio in background. Turn them all off to pause when minimizing, turning the screen off or switching apps. In the background the notification and headset buttons work.
faq.external_subs.q: How do I add subtitles from a file?
faq.external_subs.a: If the subtitle file sits next to the video with the same name (e.g. Movie.en.srt), the player finds it. Otherwise: Subtitles panel → Load from file. SRT, ASS/SSA, VTT and TTML are supported; the encoding is detected automatically.
faq.subs_delay.a: Subtitles panel → Delay, in 0.1 s steps. The delay is remembered for this file.
faq.dual_subs.q: Can I show two subtitle tracks at once?
faq.dual_subs.a: Yes: Subtitles panel → Second subtitles. They appear at the top — handy for learning languages.
faq.smart_tracks.q: Why did the player pick the audio and subtitles by itself?
faq.smart_tracks.a: It remembers your choices — per series and per similar set of languages (anime — Japanese with subtitles, movies — dubbed). Turn off: Settings → Remember track choice; reset: Forget track habits.
faq.open_file_tv.q: How do I open a file from a USB stick or drive on a TV?
faq.open_file_tv.a: The Open file button opens the built-in browser on a TV: internal storage, drives and USB sticks. Allow file access the first time. Blu-ray folders and ISO images open as discs; files in a folder play as a playlist.
faq.smb.q: A network folder (SMB) shows no folders or no access
faq.smb.a: Many NAS boxes don't allow guests: add the server with a username and password (Network → Add server). An empty folder list means this user has no access to shares — check permissions on the NAS. SMB 2/3 is supported.
faq.dlna.q: My media server (Jellyfin, Plex, Kodi) isn't found
faq.dlna.a: Discovery works on one network and is sometimes blocked by the router. Add the server by hand: Network → Add media server → an address like 192.168.1.10:8096. Jellyfin needs the DLNA plugin enabled.
faq.iptv.q: How do I watch TV channels (IPTV)?
faq.iptv.a: TV channels → Add playlist: an M3U link from your provider or a file. The TV guide comes from the playlist or a separate XMLTV link. On a remote, switch channels with up/down and CH+/CH−.
faq.covers.q: Where do the covers in Continue watching come from?
faq.covers.a: From the file itself (MP4/MP3/FLAC artwork), from the media server, or from images next to it: poster.jpg, folder.jpg, cover.jpg, <file name>.jpg or -thumb.jpg; for episodes — the series poster from the folder above the season. It's looked up once, 10 seconds after playback starts.
faq.torrent_peers.a: Nobody is seeding right now, or the network blocks torrents. Wait a minute: the player asks trackers and DHT by itself. If there are still no peers, this torrent has no seeds. Only download what you're allowed to watch.
faq.torrent_stop.q: How do I stop or resume a torrent?
faq.torrent_stop.a: In the Torrents list swipe a torrent left to stop, right to resume (or use the ⏸/▶ buttons). A stopped torrent neither downloads nor uploads; it resumes by itself when you start watching. The color shows the state: orange — downloading, green — seeding, grey — stopped.
faq.torrent_space.q: How much space do torrents take?
faq.torrent_space.a: Torrent settings (gear on the Torrents screen): cache limit, whether to keep files after watching, and after how many days unopened torrents are removed. Defaults: up to 20 GB, one week.
faq.handoff.q: How do I continue watching on another device?
faq.handoff.a: In the player — the Send to device button (screens icon): pick a TV or phone and it continues from the same position while this one pauses. Or on the other device's home screen — the On other devices section.
faq.handoff_code.q: What are the code and the "… wants to connect" request?
faq.handoff_code.a: Protection when several players share a network: a new device connects once — tap Allow in the request or enter the code (shown in the request and in Settings → Hand-off between devices). The daily code changes every day, but connected devices stay connected. Forget connected devices resets everything.
faq.handoff_mobile.q: Why doesn't hand-off work over mobile internet?
faq.handoff_mobile.a: Devices find each other and connect directly on the local network. Over a mobile network this is impossible (carrier NAT). Use one Wi-Fi network — or turn on the phone's hotspot and connect the TV to it.
faq.sleep.a: Yes: the moon button in the player — in 15–120 minutes or at the end of the episode. The sound fades out and the player pauses.
faq.skip_intro.q: How do I skip intros and credits?
faq.skip_intro.a: The player finds them from chapters, by sound (comparing episodes of one series) or from your marks (Chapters panel → mark intro start/end — for the whole series). Mode: Settings → Intros and credits: off, a Skip button, or automatically.
faq.languages.q: How do I translate the player into my language?
faq.languages.a: Settings → Export translation template, translate the strings in the file and import it back. Russian and English are built in.
faq.embed.q: Can I embed the player in my app?
faq.embed.a: Yes: via Intent (compatible with MX Player and VLC) or as the player-core library. Docs: docs/EMBEDDING.md and docs/API.md in the repository. License GPL v3: an app embedding the library must be open source too.
faq.torrent_network.q: How do I keep torrents off mobile data?
faq.torrent_network.a: Torrent settings (gear on the Torrents screen) → Network. "Seed on Wi-Fi" (default): watch anywhere, but on mobile data background torrents wait for Wi-Fi and upload is almost off. "Wi-Fi only": torrents do not run on mobile data, the player asks before watching. The same dialog sets how long to seed, seeding only while charging and a download limit on mobile data.
faq.frame_rate.a: Turn on Settings → Playback → "Match display frame rate": the TV switches to 23.976/24/25/50 Hz for the film. The screen blanks for 1–3 seconds while switching — that's normal. Some TVs and boxes do this on their own.
faq.stats.q: How do I find out why playback stutters?
faq.stats.a: In the player open Info (ⓘ) → "Stats for nerds". It shows the video decoder (hardware or software), dropped frames, buffer fill, network speed and CPU load. Software 4K decoding and DTS-HD decoded without a receiver are the heaviest cases.
faq.camera_stream.q: How do I show the phone camera in OBS or on a TV?
faq.camera_stream.a: Home → Camera: choose the camera and quality, press Start streaming. You get an address like rtsp://192.168.1.5:8554/ and a QR code. OBS: Media Source → untick Local File → paste the address. On a TV with 2160 Player: Link → the address. The phone and the viewer must be on the same network. Streaming continues with the app minimized — stop it from the notification.
